findings.description: The bucket is explicitly commented as public with no acl set to private and no public access block configured, allowing unauthenticated read/write access to potentially sensitive data.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket are not encrypted at rest.
A customer master data file (customer-master.xlsx) is uploaded to the aws_s3_bucket.data bucket, which is public and unencrypted, exposing potentially sensitive customer data to unauthorized access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined for this financials bucket, leaving sensitive financial data unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so data in the operations bucket is stored unencrypted.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so data in the data_science bucket is stored unencrypted.
